verdict.rationale: Solid's own materials state that when state changes only the code depending on it re-runs. They describe signals with accessor/setter, automatic dependency tracking, function-wrapped derived state, and fine-grained DOM updates instead of a virtual DOM, all within a render-once component model. Community users independently confirm granular computed updates without wasted re-renders and call it fine-grained reactivity done fully. missing for 10: in-depth first-party reference docs beyond README-level claims, and safeguards (e.g., lint warnings) against the documented pitfall where destructuring props/stores silently loses reactivity.
